entries.zh: 相好；互相亲爱、结为相好（17世纪西语 amancebarse，兼指男女私通、姘居）
entries.en: to become lovers, to be fond of each other; to live in concubinage (amancebarse)

entries.zh: 与某人相好（「共伊好」即与他／她好）；与人姘居厮守
entries.en: to be on loving terms with someone (lit. 'be good with him/her'); to keep company as lovers

entries.zh: 割不断；相恋胶着、亲密难分（西语谓相好者同居而不相离）
entries.en: (the bond) cannot be severed — inseparable lovers who keep together and do not part

entries.zh: 相欠债；俗谓前世互欠、今生相缠相好，指长久相好的情人（西语谓相好多年）
entries.en: lovers bound as if by mutual debt (相欠债); long-standing lovers/concubines

entries.zh: 契家；结契相好、姘居成家（西语注：如靠姘妇营利过活之姘夫，即 rufián 一类人）
entries.en: a contracted mate / common-law pairing (契家); a kept man or paramour, like the rufián who profits from a woman
entries.notes: 契家的具体所指须借西语描述（姘居、如 rufián 营利）推定，非四栏直证。

entries.zh: 熟骨；熟到贴骨，形容极亲昵、有意相守不分离
entries.en: 'familiar to the bone' — deeply intimate, deliberately inseparable lovers

entries.zh: 熟查某（原件作「么」，俗写通「某」）；与女子厮熟，指所姘识之妇女、同居之姘妇
entries.en: 'familiar woman' (熟查某); a woman one consorts with or keeps as concubine (barragana)
entries.notes: 么为「某」之俗写；同居姘妇义据西语 barragán。

entries.zh: 嫽娋；男女狎昵厮混、淫行奸情（西语 amancebamiento＝姘居、puteria＝淫乱）
entries.en: wanton dalliance; lewdness, concubinage (amancebamiento, putería)
entries.notes: 「嫽娋」二字生僻，义据西语两注词推定；M 栏第二音节声调号污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 黎明；天亮、拂晓（西语谓明日清晨）
entries.en: dawn, daybreak ('al amanecer', with manuscript note 'mañana' = tomorrow morning)

entries.zh: 惜；疼爱、怜惜、珍爱（西语词头为 amar 之截写）
entries.en: to love, to cherish, to pity (Sp. amar)
entries.notes: source_L 仅存「A Mar.」，推断为 amar 之缩写截断；source_M 之 gelan 一词未能确解。

entries.zh: 惜福；爱惜福分、珍惜自己的福气
entries.en: to cherish one's blessings/fortune (lit. 'to love one's source')

entries.zh: 惜死；惜命贪生、不肯舍命（即爱惜性命）
entries.en: to cling to life, to be fond of living

entries.zh: 惜性命；珍爱生命、惜命怕死
entries.en: to cherish one's (own) life

entries.zh: 相惜；互相爱惜、彼此珍重（惺惺相惜之意）
entries.en: to cherish each other; mutual affection and appreciation
entries.notes: source_L「amar seruos arbos」文字残乱难解，释义据 H/M/R 之相惜与上下文推定。

entries.zh: 爱；爱恋、疼爱（闽南语兼作「想要、喜欢」讲）
entries.en: to love, to desire; in Hokkien also 'to want, to like'

entries.zh: 爱慕；倾心爱恋、深情思慕（原件作「暮」，疑为「慕」之形误）
entries.en: to love with affection, to adore (爱慕; manuscript writes 暮, likely for 慕)
entries.notes: 封存件已标[疑：暮/慕]；据西语 afectuosamente（深情地爱）定为爱慕义。

entries.zh: 好；喜爱、好尚（此处作动词「喜欢」解，非「美好」之义）
entries.en: to like, to be fond of (好 as verb; cf. its adjective sense 'good')

entries.zh: 好色；贪恋女色、淫欲（西语谓爱不正当之事）
entries.en: to lust, to be lecherous ('to love dishonest/unlawful things')

entries.zh: 宠爱、嬖幸其下；偏爱下人（或缘其德、或受其惑）
entries.en: to dote on an inferior, or for his virtues or through his wiles; improper favor to a dependent
entries.notes: H 栏「罷」与 M、R 两栏对音皆不合，疑有形讹（宠／嬖／纵之类），本字无法确证，义据西语释义推定。

entries.zh: 宠爱；因其德行而格外垂爱、偏爱优待（H「罷爱」疑为「宠爱」）
entries.en: to favor and dote on someone for his virtues (宠爱)
entries.notes: 「罷」疑为「宠」之形讹，据 R 栏对音与西语义定为宠爱；L 末词 actuo 难解。

entries.zh: 宠幸、嬖幸；偏爱纵容（谓极爱其下、纵使其人恶劣）
entries.en: to favor excessively an inferior even if he is wicked (宠幸/嬖幸)
entries.notes: 同前「罷」疑形讹；据 R 栏对音与西语「纵其恶而偏爱」定为宠幸义。

entries.zh: 宠赐；（君王）垂爱加赏、恩宠赏赐
entries.en: (of a king) to favor and reward; imperial favor and bestowal (宠赐)
entries.notes: 同前「罷」疑形讹（据 R 栏对音当为「宠」）；「赐」字之 R 栏对音与字音不合，存疑。
